description_en: Retrieves the config items for a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListConfigItems获取指定实例下的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-config-items --instance-id ccc-test --object-id ccc-test --object-type INSTANCE --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListConfigItems

parameters.description_en: The ID of the object to which the config item applies. This can be the ID of an Alibaba Cloud account, an instance, a skill group, or an agent.
parameters.description_zh: 配置信息所属的对象的ID，可以是阿里云主账号ID、实例ID、技能组ID、坐席ID。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the object to which the config item applies. This can be the ID of an Alibaba Cloud account, an instance, a skill group, or an agent
